summary: The FPC Staff acknowledged the concern, noting that while reproductive success of spawning runs appears very low, the runs are considered a unique and desirable feature, and that spawning would probably still occur during construction though success could be adversely affected.
text: The SCWMRD and Trout Unlimited have expressed concern that construction of the Bad Creek Project would have an adverse impact on the spawning runs of trout that have been observed in 1 wer Howard Creek. At present, the reproductive success of these runs appears to be very low. Whether or not such spawning, even if successful, would significantly add to trout production in Lake Jocassee has not been determined. Nevertheless, these spawning runs are considered a unique and desirable feature (Timmerman, 1976), and provide the opportunity for fishermen to catch large trout in a small stream. The spawning runs would probably still occur even during the construction period, although spawning success could be adversely affected.
